signingTask: Isolated branch for user-approved0.1.94 artifact signing only. Runtime worktree and its pending acceptance remain untouched. Baseline contract below is preserved as historical context, not marked completed by this task.
currentRequest: 2026-09-09: Fix the installed v0.1.89 regression where Viewer turns black during the normal lock-screen/PIN transition, and allow authenticated remote input to operate a SYSTEM-owned window such as the observed nProtect warning. The affected PC has no WonRemote Secure Capture task and its packaged Agent/native capture components expose different secure-desktop capabilities. Match the proven Windows architecture seen in the installed Mastersoft product: a LocalSystem broker launches an active-console worker that attaches to the current input desktop. Make install/update and first launch self-heal the broker, reject incompatible release resources, preserve Windows authentication, and do not build or deploy until explicitly requested.
clipboardChange: 2026-09-08: Remote shortcuts must use only the remote clipboard. Local clipboard transfer requires an explicit toolbar action; remove automatic synchronization including saved preferences. Build/deployment deferred until this change is verified.
intent: Use the existing GitHub signing key only for two explicitly approved0.1.94 installers, refusing changed bytes, published releases or extra assets; upload a verified manifest without publication.
rollback: Do not merge this signing-only branch into main. Cancel its workflow if validation fails; it only adds a manifest to a draft. Retain v0.1.90 latest until separate live verification and explicit publication.
deploymentBlockers: Do not release until the implemented v0.1.88 LocalAppData-to-ProgramFiles migration, protected runtime health, legacy cleanup and rollback are physically proven on an installed Agent.
Taskbar input remote verification is assigned to the user; awaiting their result.
Installed cross-client metadata proof and existing request-budget gaps remain pending.

authenticodeStatus: No code-signing certificate in CurrentUser/LocalMachine My stores or configured Process/User/Machine PFX variables. Public-trust issuance requires user identity/account setup. Existing release policy makes Authenticode optional; unsigned status alone is not a deployment blocker. Installers remain unsigned.

requestReview.reason: One manually dispatched CI signing operation, no product request paths or production database changes. It performs two draft metadata reads, two installer downloads and one manifest upload; no polling, listeners or retries. Existing client lifecycle unchanged.
